Now |Cara − Dev| = 2 → |8 − Dev| = 2 → Dev = 6 or 10 → Dev = 6.

Ann before Gus → Gus > 4. Remaining slots: 3, 4? Wait used: 1 Ivo, 2 Finn, 4 Ann, 5 Elif, 6 Dev, 7 Ben, 8 Cara, 9 Hana. Left slot 3 for Gus.  
But Ann before Gus → 4 < 3 false. So Elif=5 fails.

**Case Elif = 6:**

Cara ≥ 7, Cara ≠ 8 (Ben) → Cara = 7 or 9.

If Cara = 9 → Hana > 9 impossible. So Cara = 7, Hana = 9.

|Cara − Dev| = 2 → |7 − Dev| = 2 → Dev = 5 or 9. 9 taken by Hana → Dev = 5.  
Check Dev > Ann(4) ✅. Dev and Hana at least 3 apart: |5 − 9| = 4 ✅.  
Elif and Cara at least 3 apart: |6 − 7| = 1 < 3 ❌.

So Elif=6 fails.
